```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(phyloseq)  # For working with phyloseq objects
library(vegan)     # For NMDS and distance matrix calculations
library(ggplot2)   # For creating plots
install.packages('viridis')
library(viridis)   # For the viridis color scale
library(dplyr)     # For data manipulation
```

```{r}
# Summon filtered physeq object 
Final_path <- "/Users/oo21097/Desktop/MRES_Kimbe_Bay/Microbial_Data/Novogene_Results/00.CleanData/Final_Dada2"
kimbe_phyloseq_rare <- readRDS(file.path(Final_path, "kimbe_phyloseq_rare.rds"))

# Filter for sediment samples and transform data
kimbe_water <- subset_samples(kimbe_phyloseq_rare, SampleType == "W")
sample_data(kimbe_phyloseq_rare)
# Tax glom at Family level 
kimbe_water_glom <- tax_glom(kimbe_water, taxrank = "Family", bad_empty = c(NA), NArm = TRUE)  

# Perform NMDS
nmds_kimbe_water <- ordinate(kimbe_water, method = "NMDS", distance = "bray")

# Check NMDS stress
nmds_kimbe_water$stress  # Should ideally be < 0.2

# Create plotting dataframe
kimbe_nmds_df_water <- data.frame(
  NMDS1 = nmds_kimbe_water$points[,1],
  NMDS2 = nmds_kimbe_water$points[,2],
  Location = sample_data(kimbe_water)$Location, 
  Depth = sample_data(kimbe_water)$Depth
)

my_font <- "Verdana"
location_labels <- c("KA" = "Lagoon A", "KD" = "Lagoon D", "KE" = "Lagoon E", "KM" = "Control")
# Create enhanced NMDS plot
kimbe_nmds_plot_water <- ggplot(kimbe_nmds_df_water, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = Location, shape = Depth)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5)  +
   ggforce::geom_mark_ellipse(aes(fill = Location), expand = 0, alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
  scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Location", 
                       labels = location_labels) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Location", 
                       labels = location_labels) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = my_font),
    axis.text = element_text(family = my_font, size = 8, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(family = my_font, size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 1, fill = "transparent"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "NMDS1",
    y = "NMDS2"
  )
# Display and save the plot
print(kimbe_nmds_plot_water)

ggsave( "/Users/oo21097/Desktop/MRES_Kimbe_Bay/Microbial_Data/figures/Kimbe/kimbe_nmds_plot_water.png", plot = kimbe_nmds_plot_water, width = 8, height = 5  , dpi = 300)
save(kimbe_nmds_df_water, file = "kimbe_nmds_df_water.RData")

```

```{r}
library(vegan)
if (!requireNamespace("devtools", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("pmartinezarbizu/pairwiseAdonis/pairwiseAdonis")
library(pairwiseAdonis)

# Calculate Bray-Curtis distances
kimbe_bray_water <- phyloseq::distance(kimbe_water_glom, method = "bray")

# Extract sample data
kimbe_metadata_water <- data.frame(sample_data(kimbe_water_glom))

# PERMANOVA
kimbe_adonis2_result_water <- adonis2(kimbe_bray_water ~ Location * DepthCategory, data = kimbe_metadata_water, permutations = 999)

print(kimbe_adonis2_result_water)
```

```{r}
library(pairwiseAdonis)

# Run pairwise PERMANOVA for Location
pairwise.adonis2(
  kimbe_bray_water ~ Location,
  data = kimbe_metadata_water,
  permutations = 999,
  p.adjust.m = "bonferroni"  # adjust p-values for multiple testing
)

# OR run pairwise PERMANOVA for DepthCategory
pairwise.adonis2(
  kimbe_bray_water ~ DepthCategory,
  data = kimbe_metadata_water,
  permutations = 999,
  p.adjust.m = "bonferroni"
)

# OR for Location × DepthCategory interaction
kimbe_metadata_water$Group <- interaction(kimbe_metadata_water$Location, kimbe_metadata_water$DepthCategory)

pairwise.adonis2(
  kimbe_bray_water ~ Group,
  data = kimbe_metadata_water,
  permutations = 999,
  p.adjust.m = "bonferroni"
)

```
